newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT-Chartists neutral on reweighted Bel-20.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Chartists neutral on reweighted Bel-20.

text.p: Belgian shares are seen seeking new direction after a reweighting of the Bel-20 index on Friday left analysts divided on the technical outlook for the market.
The Bel-20 ended at 1,765.06 points last Friday, up slightly from its September 13 close of 1,757.92.

CERA - Changes in the weightings of stocks in the Bel-20 led to high volume last week but the effect on individual stocks was not that great. CERA Bank did a test by comparing the Bel-20 with the old and the new weightings. When we started the comparison on April 18, the day the changes in the Bel-20 were announced, we saw that the Bel-20 with the new weightings outperformed the actual Bel-20 by 35 points. In the near future we believe that the Belgian budget debate will influence the stock exchange. First resistance is the previous high of 1,773, set on May 28, with second resistance at the psychologically important 1,800 level -- Guy Sips.

ECOFIS - Last week's star and hanging man in the weekly chart just below the all-time highs point to toppishness. The working assumption should therefore be that, since March 1996, the Bel-20 is in an extended top formation. This thesis is further strengthened by the uninterrupted divergence below the relative strength indicator and the Bel-20 over the last nine months, and by the fact that 10-year OLO futures are strongly overbought -- Frank Boll.
GENERALE BANK - Charts distorted by Bel-20 adjustment.

PARIBAS - On daily charts the Bel-20 is forming an ascending triangle pattern with 1,775-1,780 as major resistance and 1,740 as support. If the triangle breaks significantly on the upside we set our target at levels towards 1,825 and 1,885 on a medium-term basis. A break on the downside however would leave the Bel-20 testing the 1,710 level, a low reached on September 3 -- Philip Tortelboom.
